brief:
German police arrested at least two demonstrators during a pro-Palestine march in Berlin on Saturday, Shehab Wire reported. The protest was held in opposition to Israel's ongoing military operations in Gaza, with dozens of activists participating in the demonstration through the German capital's streets.

The arrests took place on Ohlander Street as the march progressed. The incident marked another instance of police intervention at pro-Palestinian demonstrations in Berlin, a city that has seen repeated protests over the conflict in Gaza.
